name: Garden of Terror
theme: Gather Seeds from awakened Shamblers to summon Garden Terrors down all three lanes.
firstObjective: Warning at 1:45, spawns at 2:15 (~2:00 cooldown after a Garden Terror push ends)
spawnPattern: Spawns across 3 vertical lane/column zones; never spawns 3 times in a row on the same half of the map (verify exact column/half rule)

mechanic.title: Seed Gathering & Triple Garden Terrors
mechanic.description: Channeling an active Seed awakens Shambler defenders that must be cleared to claim the Seed. Collecting 3 Seeds unleashes a Garden Terror down every lane simultaneously, disabling enemy buildings and casting Polymorph zones that turn nearby enemy units and Heroes into harmless treants/critters.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left and bottom-right. Long-range siege mercenaries; good to capture right before Seed phases.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper-mid and lower-mid pathways. Durable melee mercenaries with a Spell Armor aura that create strong side/mid pressure.

strategy: Garden of Terror revolves around soaking, camp control, and building toward a 3-Seed power spike that pushes all three lanes at once. Clear camps before Seed phases to force split rotations, and push alongside your strongest Garden Terror lane with high-clear/siege heroes to break structures while enemies scramble to defend multiple lanes.
notes: Because Garden of Terror has no Boss camp, 3-Seed pushes and stacked mercenary waves carry extra structure value—watch out for counter-pushes if your team overcommits to a single Seed while losing waves elsewhere.
